properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued August 3 at 9:57AM EDT until August 3 at 1:00PM EDT by NWS Upton NY
properties.description:
FFWOKX

The National Weather Service in Upton has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Middlesex County in southern Connecticut...
Southeastern New Haven County in southern Connecticut...
New London County in southern Connecticut...

* Until 100 PM EDT.

* At 957 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy downpours and
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between
1 and 2.5 inches of rain have fallen over the last 6 hours.
Rainfall rate of 1 to 2 inches in 1 hour are likely. Additional
rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches are possible in the warned area
through 1pm. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as
other poor drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Jewett City, Middletown, Norwich, New London, Guilford,
Colchester, Clinton, East Hampton, Groton, Old Saybrook, Durham,
Salem, Chester, Mystic, Branford, Waterford, East Lyme, Ledyard,
North Branford and Griswold.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Stay away or be swept away. River banks and culverts can become
unstable and unsafe.
properties.area: Middlesex, CT; New Haven, CT; New London, CT

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 3 at 9:53AM EDT until August 3 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
SMWTBW

The National Weather Service in Ruskin has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Tarpon Springs to Suwannee River FL out 20
NM...
Waters from Tarpon Springs to Suwannee River FL out 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 1100 AM EDT.

* At 953 AM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 7 nm northeast of Yankeetown to 9 nm west of Ozello
to 24 nm west of Bayport, moving east at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 40 knots.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours. Make sure
all on board are wearing life jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Ozello, Crystal River, and Yankeetown.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued August 2 at 8:24PM CDT until August 5 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage early
Wednesday afternoon and continue falling to 6.9 feet Friday
evening.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 18.7
feet on 07/20/1990.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.
